separate_experiment_statement: This is a NEW, separately registered experiment. It is NOT S1 v1 and must never be presented as S1 v1. S1 v1 (FEDCORE-S1-DOMAINNET-PACSCLS-20260923-v1, sha256 e7dc391888db2abc9993e19762ff84959098a10063bc67566d2f5cbb9d1a3173) was declared INVALID_BY_PROTOCOL on 2026-09-25 because the DomainNet 345-class taxonomy contains no "person" class. v2 is registered AFTER that failure, which was a class-availability failure observed from label lists only (no DomainNet image decoded, no model output computed). S1 v1 remains INVALID permanently.
information_available_at_seal: DomainNet official cleaned label lists (class names and per-class counts only; hashes in refs/official_cleaned_lists.sha256)
HTTP HEAD metadata (Content-Length/ETag/Last-Modified) of the 6 official zips
V1 checkpoint sha256 and V1 code sha256 (gate PASS in S1 v1 run)
information_NOT_available_at_seal: any DomainNet model output (logits, scores, predictions)
target_claim: Under the 30 frozen V1 PACS predictors (no retraining), does the V1-registered selection rule V1_SCALE_CP (vs the 7 equal-information/equal-budget fixed procedures) retain its ECA advantage on an external domain collection (DomainNet, 6 official domains) restricted to the 6 PACS class names present in DomainNet? No new testing principle; no predictor SOTA; no RATIO general-superiority claim; no geometry-alone causation claim; results are descriptive of transfer and never rewrite V1.

do_not_edit: S1 v1 protocol and its INVALID outputs
scientific_freeze.forbid_post_outcome_changes: thresholds, budgets, replicates, endpoints, class/domain lists, gates, bootstrap seed are fixed here and may not change after any DomainNet output is seen
scientific_freeze.on_KILL_or_HOLD: Keep V1 HOLD narrative; S1 v2 is reported as an additional descriptive transfer probe; never reinterpret V1 as CONFIRM.

dataset.name: DomainNet
dataset.source_paper: Peng et al., Moment Matching for Multi-Source Domain Adaptation, ICCV 2019
dataset.version: CLEANED (the version the official page labels "cleaned version, recommended")
dataset.version_rationale: (i) The official page recommends it; (ii) cleaning removed duplicated images (credited to G. Kang), which is aligned with V1's duplicate-collapse identity rule; (iii) the cleaned label lists are exactly the lists whose hashes were already recorded in the S1 v1 evidence (official_cleaned_txt.sha256); (iv) V1-style label lists (path + integer label, class taken from the path) apply directly. For infograph/quickdraw/real/sketch the cleaned and original sections link the SAME zip URL; cleaning is realised by the cleaned lists. For clipart/painting the cleaned section links groundtruth/{domain}.zip.
dataset.domain_order: alphabetical (as listed); this order defines client index j=0..5
dataset.zip_sha256: recorded at download and bound in DATA_BINDING.md/json addendum in the run directory; this addendum is NOT an analysis choice. A Content-Length mismatch is a transport error (re-download), never a reason to change source.
dataset.label_lists_used: BOTH train and test lists (union). The DomainNet train/test partition plays no role because predictors are frozen and never trained on DomainNet.
dataset.excluded_class: person (absent from DomainNet taxonomy; not substituted by face/hand/etc.)
dataset.class_filter: Class = second path component of the list entry (e.g. clipart/dog/xxx.jpg -> dog), case-insensitive exact match after strip against the 6 names. Integer label must be consistent within a class name (else INVALID).
dataset.image_selection: ALL list entries (train union test) of the 6 classes in all 6 domains; no subsampling; no image selection by content. Files present in a zip but absent from the cleaned lists are excluded.
dataset.identity: SHA256 of uint32-big-endian width,height followed by decoded EXIF-transposed RGB bytes (V1)
dataset.duplicate_rule: V1: collapse identical RGB content within a domain and class (keep lexicographically smallest path); identical content with conflicting class labels within a domain -> INVALID; same content across domains kept, same role automatically (role is a function of identity).
dataset.role_rule: H=int(SHA256(protocol_id|role|image_identity)) with protocol_id=FEDCORE-S1-DOMAINNET6-PACSCLS-20260925-v2; proposal if 2*H < 2**256, audit otherwise. No training role.
dataset.role_rule_rationale: V1 used 60/20/20 train/proposal/audit because it trained predictors. S1 predictors are frozen, so a training share would discard ~60% of scarce support (smallest cell clipart/dog = 70 listed) with no scientific purpose. The V1 proposal:audit ratio (1:1) is preserved. Proposal and audit remain disjoint.
dataset.split_rule: The 5 V1 known/unknown splits are copied verbatim (the frozen 4-way heads fix them); person is removed from the DomainNet data only, never from the heads.

person_asymmetry.person_known_rule: Predictor used exactly as frozen: full 4-way head, all 4 logits enter msp/energy/margin and argmax; no logit removal, masking or renormalisation. The person head receives no inputs. Any argmax=person on a known-class DomainNet image is a wrong-known error and any acceptance of an unknown image is an error, exactly as V1 err=(label<0)|(argmax!=label).
person_asymmetry.person_unknown_rule: Unknown set has 2 classes instead of 3; nothing else changes.
person_asymmetry.V1_rule_check: V1 adapter.proposals/counts_for_draws define err=(labels<0)|(argmax!=labels) with scores over all 4 known logits; the rule above IS V1's rule, so no structural adaptation is needed for person. Only the class support differs.
person_asymmetry.primary_analysis: All 5 splits, 30 models, V1 aggregation (average over 5 splits x 3 seeds x 2 t per architecture).
person_asymmetry.secondary_sensitivity_analysis: Splits {0,3,4} only (person unknown; all 4 known heads supported): 9 models per architecture; the same 16 contrasts, same bootstrap generator/seed/quantiles, and the V1 decision function evaluated DESCRIPTIVELY. It never overrides the primary verdict. The complement {1,2} is reported descriptively too.
person_asymmetry.person_prediction_diagnostic: Post-decision only: fraction of full audit-frame images whose argmax is person in splits 1,2, per architecture/domain (descriptive).

predictors.binding: 1:1 to V1 (arch, split, seed); sha256 must equal refs/V1_CHECKPOINT_SHA256.txt (=V1 RUN_ARTIFACTS); state digest must equal V1 RUN_STATE state_sha256
predictors.load: V1 adapter.build_model(arch, V1_protocol_id, split, seed) then load_state_dict(checkpoint.state) strictly; eval mode
predictors.inference_transform: identical to V1: EXIF transpose/RGB; Resize(256, bilinear, antialias=True); CenterCrop(224); ToTensor; Normalize(ImageNet mean/std)
predictors.inference_precision: FP32, no AMP, no TF32, V1 deterministic_torch(); batch size 32
predictors.implementation_note: For speed, EXIF/RGB/Resize/CenterCrop may be computed once per image and cached as uint8 224x224; ToTensor+Normalize are then applied with the same float32 ops. The dry-check must show max|x_cached - x_V1transform| == 0 on a subset, else the cache is not used. num_workers is a non-scientific setting.
predictors.missing_checkpoint_policy: any of 30 missing -> INCOMPLETE; hash mismatch -> INVALID; no substitution

candidate_family: COPIED from V1 verbatim (12 candidates: msp/energy/margin x gamma {0.3,0.5,0.7,1.0}; thresholds unique numpy.quantile(proposal_scores, linspace(0,1,300)); pooled proposal over all 6 domains unweighted by record; K/A<=gamma/5, A>=1; min proposal coverage 0.01; reject-all slot kept; certified selection = max common acceptance LCB, ties smaller gamma, score alias, index). Executed by the unmodified V1 adapter.proposals.

audit.J_rationale: J = number of clients = number of domains (V1: 4 PACS domains). The V1 certifier is generic in J (uses A.shape[-1]); every tail keeps its V1 formula evaluated at J=6.
audit.risk_tails: as V1 formulas with J=6 (e.g. RATIO dr/(3JM)=.05/216, MASS_CP dr/(2JM)=.05/144)
audit.allocation: equal per client: n_B = floor(B/6) draws per domain = 42/85/170 for B=256/512/1024; realised totals 252/510/1020
audit.remainder_rule: The remainder B - 6*floor(B/6) (4/2/4 draws) is NOT drawn for any domain. Rationale: V1 contract is equal per client with identical n across domains and methods; floor never exceeds the registered total B; no domain receives extra information. Total B itself is unchanged from V1/S1 v1.
audit.small_cell_rule: Draws are with replacement from the identity-sorted per-domain audit frame (all 6 classes pooled within a domain), so a cell smaller than any budget (e.g. infograph giraffe 168 listed, clipart dog 70, sketch horse 101) needs no floor: nothing is drawn per cell. Cell sizes only enter via the support gate below.
audit.draws: nested fixed-size prefixes of the V1 256-length stream: adapter.audit_indices(protocol_id_v2, split, domain, replicate, audit_frame_size)[:n_B]; NumPy PCG64; no adaptive stopping
audit.draw_seed: V1 seed function, label=audit_draw, parts=[split, domain, replicate], protocol_id = v2 id
audit.coupling: same (split,domain,replicate) stream across architectures, seeds, methods, both t and all budgets (V1)
audit.certifier_information: proposal eligibility plus n,A,K count tensors only (V1)
audit.full_frame_truth: post-decision only (V1 truth_summaries/joint_failure with J=6 vertices)

procedures.diagnostic_role: Required report; not a fixed comparator; not part of CONFIRM/TRANSFER.

analysis.primary_metric: ECA = common acceptance LCB of the selected certified candidate; refusal = 0 (V1)
analysis.per_arch_estimand: Average over 5 fixed splits, 3 fixed seeds (frozen V1 predictors) and 2 equally weighted t; expectation over fresh with-replacement draws conditional on the frozen DomainNet frames and predictors
analysis.statistical_unit: one complete audit-replicate block across all 30 models; 100 blocks (V1)
analysis.CI: paired percentile bootstrap of 100 replicate blocks, 20000 resamples, shared indices, linear quantiles .05/(2*16) and 1-.05/(2*16) (V1)
analysis.bootstrap_seed_note: NEW seed registered here, before any DomainNet output; not V1 2026091601, not S1 v1 2026092301
analysis.implementation: V1 analysis functions contrasts/bootstrap/truth_groups/decide/per_model_support/outcome_rows/assemble are reused unmodified by passing a v2 constants dict; only protocol_constants (which hard-codes J=4 and the V1 seed) and the domain list are re-specified in a thin v2 wrapper.
secondary: per-model deltas, per-split seed means, win/tie/loss
descriptive comparison with V1 locked numbers
analysis.missing: retain full matrix; failed/incomplete not imputed as refusal or zero
analysis.V1_comparison: Descriptive side-by-side of V1 locked contrasts vs S1 v2 contrasts; no pooling, no test of difference, no rewrite of V1.

gates.CONFIRM: All 30 models and all primary rows complete and valid; in EACH architecture min of the seven mean paired differences >= .01 AND all 14 CI lowers > 0 (V1, unchanged)
gates.KILL: Any architecture has any fixed-control CI upper <= 0, OR in BOTH architectures min mean fixed-control difference < .002 (V1, unchanged)
gates.HOLD: Complete valid result that is neither CONFIRM nor KILL (V1)
gates.INVALID: Leakage, changed outcome-dependent knobs, wrong certification, unequal information/budgets, source/data binding failure, pre-GPU data gates below, or any class/domain list change
gates.HOLD_VALIDITY: For any of 30*3*2*7=1260 model-budget-t-fixed-method groups, exact Bin(100,.10) upper-tail p at observed joint-failure count <= .05/1260 (V1); OR exact-identity overlap between the DomainNet frame and any V1 PACS image (V1: any detected overlap HOLD, no silent deletion)
gates.INCOMPLETE: Any missing required model or primary outcome, resource stop (8 GPU-h cap), or data not obtainable

pre_GPU_gates.rule: All 6 zips downloaded from the exact URLs above; sha256 recorded; size equals HEAD Content-Length. If any official zip cannot be obtained (dead URL, persistent failure) -> STOP, verdict INCOMPLETE_DATA; no substitute data (in particular no third-party/other-user DomainNet copies).

Every listed 6-class entry must exist in its zip and decode. Missing+undecodable entries are excluded and listed; if they exceed 0.5% of that domain's listed 6-class entries (clipart 3, infograph 6, painting 10, quickdraw 15, real 18, sketch 5; floor) -> INVALID. Integer label must be constant within each class name per domain -> else INVALID.
Within-domain identical RGB with conflicting class -> INVALID (V1). Within-class duplicates collapsed and counted.

Minimum support: each of the 36 (class, domain) cells must have >= 10 unique images in the proposal role AND >= 10 in the audit role after dedup. ANY cell failure -> whole-run INVALID (no cell or domain dropping: the J=6 equal-budget structure and all 5 splits share every cell, so dropping would silently change the domain/class list). Expected minimum from lists ~35 per role (clipart dog 70); the gate targets data/decoding failures, not tuning.
30/30 checkpoint sha256 = V1 RUN_ARTIFACTS; state digest = V1 RUN_STATE; V1 code sha256 = V1 RUN_STATE code_sha256. Missing -> INCOMPLETE; mismatch -> INVALID.
Exact identity intersection between DomainNet frame and V1 FOLD_MANIFEST identities (all PACS images). Count >0 -> HOLD_VALIDITY (images retained, listed).

On <=64 images per domain: logits shape (N,4) finite; label map per split equals label_map above; known head order alphabetical = V1 MODEL_MATRIX known list; cached transform equals V1 transform bitwise. No ECA/certificate/score summary is computed or viewed. Dry-check outputs cannot change any sealed choice; failure -> fix wiring only (no science change) and rerun dry-check, recorded.

post_run_INVALID_checks: V1 audit_checks with n == floor(B/6) per domain; rows 162000; primary rows 54000; flags 1512000; derived rows equal their sources; audit files hash-bound.

hosts.workstation4: TITAN RTX GPU 0 ONLY (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0); GPUs 1-3 never touched

resources.launch_rule: nvidia-smi check before every launch; target GPU must be idle (no foreign compute process); if workstation4 GPU0 is busy it is not used
resources.work_split: by architecture or seed when both hosts are idle; otherwise ubuntu only
resources.ledger: wall-clock GPU seconds per host logged

execution_binding.runner: new thin v2 runner importing unmodified V1 adapter/certifier/analysis; its sha256 recorded in the run directory RUN_BINDING before full inference; any divergence from this spec -> INVALID
